answer: Because a fabricated citation fails the fable check immediately, the hollow audit keeps the resolved set and the river replay publishes exactly which ids were live. Copying the same citations across 221 aliases therefore pays the reading cost 221 times, while the duplicate detector still collapses them into one signature. An answer must cite at least 5 transaction ids it builds on, and each citation is resolved against the ledger to prove it exists and predates the submission. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
